display.purpose: Hero headline only; Playfair 900, lh 1.08, max-width 13ch; clamp(2.6rem, 12vw, 3.4rem) at <=520px.

headline.purpose: Section h2s at graded clamps (speaking up to 4rem, about down to 3.2rem cap); ends with an italic-600 turn in Gold Light.

title.purpose: Path-row headings, Playfair 700, clamp(1.6rem, 2.6vw, 2.1rem); mobile-menu links 1.7rem.

marquee.purpose: Credential strip voice: Playfair 700 uppercase, 1.02rem/.14em; static wrapped row steps to .84rem at <=900px / pointer:coarse.

flourish.purpose: Playfair italic 600 in gold: path promises (1.15rem), signature (1.55rem), thank-you line (1.9rem); grey italic .85rem for quiet asides.

body.purpose: Inter 400 at 1.0625rem/1.7, max 68ch (hero sub 52ch); strong = ink 600.

label.purpose: Inter 600 uppercase 0.72-0.8rem, 0.16-0.22em tracking. Meta lines, captions, field labels, buttons, nav. Never a kicker above a heading.

shadows.name: portrait-weight
shadows.purpose: Under the about portrait only; the heaviest shadow in the system.

shadows.name: hover-lift
shadows.purpose: Gold button hover, paired with translateY(-2px).

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The single house ease for every transition and animation.

motion.name: photoIn
motion.purpose: Hero photo breathes in; reduced-motion gated.

motion.name: hero-rise
motion.purpose: Staggered hero copy entrance: bar+headline, sub, CTAs, meta line.

motion.name: marquee
motion.value: translateX(-50%), 36s linear infinite; paused on hover/focus-within
motion.purpose: Credential marquee loop; static wrapped row at <=900px / pointer:coarse.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: IntersectionObserver scroll reveals (rootMargin -8% bottom, threshold .1); visible by default without JS or with reduced motion.

motion.name: micro
motion.purpose: Color/border shifts .3s; button lift .35s; path-row hover fill .45s; link underline draw .5s; mosaic zoom scale(1.035) 1.2s.

components.name: Gold Button
components.description: The one gold primary action per view region (Book a Call / Check Availability / Send It).
components.css: .ds-btn-gold { display: inline-block; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: .8rem; letter-spacing: .18em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; padding: 1.05rem 2.1rem; border-radius: 2px; cursor: pointer; background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--gold-2, #d4af37), var(--gold, #b98a2f)); color: #14100a; border: 1px solid var(--gold-2, #d4af37); transition: transform .35s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow .35s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn-gold:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 14px 28px -14px rgba(0,0,0,.75); } .ds-btn-gold:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold, #b98a2f); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Hairline Button
components.description: The quiet secondary action beside the gold button.
components.css: .ds-btn-line { display: inline-block; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: .8rem; letter-spacing: .18em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; padding: 1.05rem 2.1rem; border-radius: 2px; cursor: pointer; background: transparent; color: var(--gold-2, #d4af37); border: 1px solid var(--rule, rgba(185,138,47,.32)); transition: transform .35s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), background-color .35s, border-color .35s, color .35s; } .ds-btn-line:hover { border-color: var(--gold-2, #d4af37); background: rgba(185,138,47,.07); color: var(--ink, #f4f1ea); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-line:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold, #b98a2f); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Engraved Link
components.description: Tertiary small-caps link on a gold hairline; a brighter line draws over it on hover.
components.css: .ds-link-engraved { position: relative; display: inline-block; text-decoration: none; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: .78rem; letter-spacing: .2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--gold-2, #d4af37); padding-bottom: .45rem; transition: color .3s; } .ds-link-engraved::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: 0; height: 1px; width: 100%; background: var(--rule, rgba(185,138,47,.32)); } .ds-link-engraved::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: 0; height: 1px; width: 100%; background: var(--gold-2, #d4af37); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform .5s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); z-index: 1; } .ds-link-engraved:hover { color: var(--ink, #f4f1ea); } .ds-link-engraved:hover::before { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-link-engraved:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold, #b98a2f); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Gold Bar
components.description: The 2px two-gold section punctuation: 76px above the hero headline, 74px closing each section head.
components.css: .ds-gold-bar { width: 74px; height: 2px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--gold-2, #d4af37), var(--gold, #b98a2f)); }

components.name: Path Row
components.description: Editorial 5fr/7fr row: title, italic gold promise, engraved link left; two-column bullet-free list right; hairline separators; Panel fill on hover.
components.html:
Families & Pre-Retirees

Retire with confidence.

  • Retirement & income planning that turns savings into a paycheck
  • RMD strategy and Roth conversions timed under the IRMAA cliff
  • Life, annuities & long-term care that protect what you've built

components.css: .ds-path { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 5fr 7fr; gap: 2rem 3.5rem; align-items: start; padding: 3.2rem 1.5rem; border-top: 1px solid rgba(244,241,234,.07); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(244,241,234,.07); transition: background-color .45s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-path:hover { background: var(--stock, #0d0f15); } .ds-path-h3 { font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.6rem; line-height: 1.08; letter-spacing: -.015em; color: var(--ink, #f4f1ea); margin: 0; } .ds-path-promise { font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif; font-style: italic; font-weight: 600; color: var(--gold-2, #d4af37); font-size: 1.15rem; margin: .7rem 0 0; } .ds-path-list { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; columns: 2; column-gap: 2.6rem; } .ds-path-list li { break-inside: avoid; padding: .55rem 0; color: var(--soft, #a7a9b4); font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: .97rem; line-height: 1.6; } .ds-path-list strong { color: var(--ink, #f4f1ea); font-weight: 600; }

components.html: Retirement & Income Strategist
components.css: .ds-marquee-item { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.02rem; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink, #f4f1ea); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-marquee-item svg { margin: 0 2.6rem; flex: none; }

components.name: Contact Field

components.css: .ds-field { max-width: 22rem; } .ds-field-label { display: block; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: .72rem; letter-spacing: .2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--gold, #b98a2f); margin-bottom: .45rem; } .ds-req { color: var(--gold-2, #d4af37); } .ds-field-input { width: 100%; background: transparent; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(244,241,234,.22); color: var(--ink, #f4f1ea); font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; padding: .65rem .1rem; border-radius: 0; transition: border-color .3s; } .ds-field-input::placeholder { color: rgba(167,169,180,.75); } .ds-field-input:focus { border-bottom-color: var(--gold, #b98a2f); outline: none; } .ds-field-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold, #b98a2f); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Offset Portrait
components.description: About-photo treatment: bare photo, heavy black shadow, gold hairline frame offset behind, navy corner tint, small-caps caption.
components.css: .ds-portrait { position: relative; margin: 16px 16px 0 16px; max-width: 280px; } .ds-portrait-photo { position: relative; z-index: 1; height: 340px; background: linear-gradient(160deg, #0b1a33, #08090c); box-shadow: 0 30px 60px -32px rgba(0,0,0,.9); } .ds-portrait-photo::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(200deg, rgba(11,26,51,.18), transparent 45%); pointer-events: none; } .ds-portrait::before { content: ""; position: absolute; z-index: 0; top: -16px; left: -16px; right: 16px; bottom: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, rgba(185,138,47,.32)); } .ds-portrait-caption { position: relative; z-index: 1; margin-top: 1.4rem; color: var(--soft, #a7a9b4); font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: .78rem; letter-spacing: .2em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.css: .ds-mosaic-fig { position: relative; margin: 0; overflow: hidden; max-width: 300px; } .ds-mosaic-img { height: 220px; background: linear-gradient(160deg, #12151d, #0b1a33 60%, #08090c); filter: saturate(.88); transition: transform 1.2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-mosaic-fig:hover .ds-mosaic-img { transform: scale(1.035); } .ds-mosaic-caption { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; z-index: 1; padding: 2.2rem 1.4rem .95rem; background: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent, rgba(8,9,12,.88)); color: var(--ink, #f4f1ea); font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: .74rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .2em; text-transform: uppercase; }

narrative.overview:
This world is a modern editorial-lux magazine feature on a near-black ground: Justin's real photography blended full-bleed into the dark, oversized Playfair Display headlines with italic gold turns, and authentic gold rationed to 2px bars, 1px hairlines, small caps, and one gold button per view. It refuses template flatness — no icon-card grids, no boxed sections, no gradient text, no glow. Sections are open compositions laid directly on the page; structure is drawn with hairline rules and asymmetric 5/7 grids, not with cards. A faint fixed film grain keeps the black from reading as flat pixels.

Photography leads. The first viewport is a split hero: the portrait bleeds in from the right behind a hairline offset frame, scrimmed into the black on every edge; copy owns the left 60%. Everywhere else the same discipline holds — images are slightly desaturated, overlaid with near-black and navy gradients, and never pasted on as bright rectangles. Motion is confident and quiet: the hero photo breathes in, copy rises on a stagger, credentials glide in a slow 36s marquee (paused on hover/focus, static on touch and narrow screens), and below-the-fold content fades up via IntersectionObserver. One ease drives everything, and the page is fully visible without JS or with reduced motion.
keyCharacteristics: Photo-forward: real photography blended into near-black with scrims, desaturation, and hairline offset frames
Oversized Playfair 900 headlines (hero up to 5.9rem, lh 1.08, -0.015em) ending in italic-600 gold turns; Inter 400-700 as the functional voice
Two-gold champagne accent (#b98a2f / #d4af37) spent on 2px gradient bars, hairlines, small caps, and a single gold button per view
Editorial full-width rows and asymmetric 5/7 grids instead of card grids; hairline rules draw all structure
A scrolling credential marquee as the trust strip — uppercase Playfair with gold diamond separators
One easing everywhere: cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1); motion opts in via JS and honors prefers-reduced-motion

rules.name: The Gold Budget Rule
rules.body: Gold is spent on 2px bars, 1px hairlines, small caps, italic turns, diamond separators, and at most one gold-filled button per view. It is never a background wash, never a text gradient, never a glow.

rules.name: The Two Golds Rule
rules.body: #b98a2f is standing gold (labels, separators, outlines, dark gradient stop); #d4af37 is gold catching light (emphasis, links, hovers, bright gradient stop). Hover resolves gold toward ink (#f4f1ea), not toward brighter gold.

rules.name: The Undertone Rule
rules.body: Navy #0b1a33 appears only inside gradients, scrims, and tints — never as a flat panel color, border, or text color.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: The small-caps voice is a voice for lines of content — the hero conference line, the speaking meta line, captions, field labels — with middot separators in Gold Rule when listed (separators hide and lines stack at <=520px). It never sits above a heading as a kicker or eyebrow. Headings introduce themselves.

rules.name: The Italic Turn Rule
rules.body: Emphasis inside any Playfair heading is italic 600 in Gold Light — never bolder weight, never underline, never a second color family.

rules.name: The Row, Not Card Rule
rules.body: Repeatable content is an editorial row divided by ink hairlines (path rows, reach list), never a grid of boxed cards. Hover may fill a row with Panel; it never adds a border or shadow.

rules.name: The Black Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every shadow and photo overlay is neutral black (or the near-black/navy scrim family) at low spread, cast downward. No colored glows, no gold halos — gold shines by contrast, not by bloom.

dos: Do blend every photograph into the ground: desaturate (saturate(.82-.88)), scrim with the near-black/navy gradient family, and let at least one edge dissolve to #08090c or carry an overlaid caption gradient.

Do draw structure with rules — Ink Hairline for row separators, Gold Rule Dim for band edges and quiet frames, Gold Rule for emphatic frames — and punctuate sections with the 2px two-gold bar (74-76px).
Do end headlines with an italic Playfair turn in Gold Light, and reserve strong-in-grey (ink, 600) as the only in-paragraph emphasis.
Do spend gold on at most one gold button per view region, pairing it with a hairline button or engraved link for the quieter path.

Do keep motion on the single house ease, opt-in via JS (html.js), gated by prefers-reduced-motion — and give any auto-playing motion a hover/focus pause plus a static fallback on touch and narrow screens.
Do mark unresolved facts as labeled placeholder slots (italic grey on dashed gold underline) with REPLACE: comments — honest slots, never invented content.
donts: Don't use gradient text. Gradients live only on surfaces (button face, 2px bars); type is always solid ink or gold.
Don't build icon-card grids or boxed section cards. The only icons are the gold diamond, hamburger, and select chevron; repeatable content is hairline-ruled editorial rows.
Don't put a kicker or small-caps eyebrow above any heading. The small-caps voice is content (meta lines, captions, labels), never a heading's warm-up.
Don't cast colored or glowing shadows. Shadows are soft black and downward; overlays stay in the near-black/navy family.
Don't round corners past the 2px stamp radius, and never on photos, frames, rows, or fields.
Don't introduce new hues or bright unscrimmed imagery. The world is a near-black ground, two panels, two inks, two golds, and a navy that lives only inside gradients.
